statement: SELECT c.model_key, c.display_name, c.target_name, c.capabilities, c.selectable, c.endpoint_state, d.preferred_model_key = c.model_key AS is_preferred FROM rag_accuracy_demo.rag_accuracy.toyota_rag_model_catalog c LEFT JOIN rag_accuracy_demo.rag_accuracy.toyota_rag_model_defaults d ON d.capability = 'embedding' AND array_contains(c.capabilities, 'embedding') WHERE c.target_kind = 'FMAPI_ENDPOINT' AND c.selectable = TRUE AND c.region_available = TRUE ORDER BY is_preferred DESC, c.display_name, c.model_key
